use_case_summary: MapleRow wants to layer a learned reranker on top of an existing retrieval pipeline. Primary goals: increase relevance for product search (B2B SaaS docs), provide a reproducible offline scoring job to label datasets, and keep p95 latency < 200ms for interactive flows while controlling per-query cost.
notes:
- PM (Aisha, product lead): 'Need consistent improvement in top-5; business cares about users finding pricing/features quickly.'
- Eng lead (Tom): prototype uses existing vector store + candidate set from Elasticsearch; wants a rerank endpoint that accepts batched offline jobs for scoring 100k queries overnight.
- POC details: hosted_api rerank endpoint used with our eval set (~10k queries, 3-grade relevance labels). Initial run: +8% top-10 recall, MAP +0.05.
- Latency: target p95 <= 200ms, observed 180ms on hosted with small batch size; throughput target for production ~200 qps sustained (we'll evaluate batching strategies).
- Model preference: start with a mid-sized open model (7-13B) with quantized variants for Dedicated. Eng asked about fallback routing to smaller model under load.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration; EU data residency for subset of customer data (legal flagged).
- Pricing ask: hosted cost projection vs Dedicated reserved pool with 6mo commit. Finance wants a 6/12 mo pricing sheet and unit costs at 100k qpm estimate.
- Quote from PM after demo: 'Hosted flow shows promise; if Dedicated brings predictability + cost benefits we will move.'
- Blockers: legal DPA + customer data residency confirmation.
- Next actions assigned: Jordan to deliver Dedicated pricing options (by 2026-03-18); Nora to run additional POC with larger eval set; Legal to review DPA (aim 2026-03-22).
- Artifacts: POC logs, hosted rerank sample payloads, eval-set.csv (10k queries) in drive.
